data.name: Roll Arena
data.detailed_description:
A stapler. A pepper grinder. A pickle launcher. Or a skill that drags everyone into a meeting.

Roll Arena is a physics-driven twin-stick roguelite where physics has a personal grudge against you. Roll, aim, shoot, bounce, and slam face-first into walls and enemies. Help Bobby and his friends destroy the daily grind: dive into the arena, loot, blow up anything that moves, and walk out with as much gold as you can carry.

Physics-driven combat

Shove enemies into walls and traps, dodge bullets, sidestep melee charges before they send you flying. Physics matters here, and simply pointing and shooting won't cut it.

Themed arenas

A TV game show. An open-plan office. A supermarket. A casino. Every arena brings its own world, enemies, items and difficulty.

200+ items to unlock

Every item was designed and tuned to make each run fun and completely different, and every arena brings new ones.

Endless mode and leaderboards

Once you've cleared an arena, put your hard-earned gold back on the line and see how much further you can push. Compare your scores with other players and show them who's on top.

Full controller support, keyboard and mouse recommended.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Xbox Gamepad OK

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
